name: Räfsnäs / Kapellskär to Norrpada and Röder outer loop
description: Northern outer-archipelago loop with exposed crossings and traffic near Kapellskär.

safety.exposure: Hard; exposed crossings, heavy traffic near Kapellskär/fairways, many weather escape choices needed.

campingRules: Norrpada nature reserve: no fires, tent/anchor max 2 nights same place, dogs leashed; valuable breeding bird area.

protectionRules.summary: Outer northern loop with likely bird/säl-protection sensitivities; exact protected-area boundaries and dates must be checked before import/navigation use.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

rules: Avoid landing on small protected skerries.
Check seasonal closures and 100 m/landing exclusions where applicable.

needsFollowup: Verify exact current protection boundaries against Naturvårdsverket Skyddad natur map before public navigation/import.
